body:
CI jobs segfaulted at random because they all share one Julia depot on NFS. When a job recompiles a package, Julia renames the new `.so` over the old one, and other jobs still running from that file crash. Recompiles happened mid-build from `test/precompile_workload.jl` and from newer caches left by other builds.

This got worse recently because `test/precompile_workload.jl` recompiles ClimaCore in every build. More builds running at the same time also means more recompiles triggered by other builds' caches.

Changes
- Add `.buildkite/hooks/pre-command`, which puts `$TMPDIR/depot` ahead of the shared depot for every step except init.
- Only init writes to the shared depot now, later recompiles stay local to the job’s node.
title: Compile into a node-local depot in every CI step after init
